Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

Raw Quartz Crystal Mineral Specimen
Natural Stone, 6.9 lbs, Approximately 8 x 5 x 6 Inches
This natural amethyst geode cluster features a deep interior hollow cavity lined with sparkling purple quartz crystal formations. The geode displays a distinct white quartz transition rim surrounded by an unpolished natural rock exterior matrix. Mineral specimens of this depth and crystal coverage make striking decorative display pieces for geological collectors, interior decor, or meditation spaces.
Deep hollow geode cavity lined with rich purple amethyst crystal points
Rough, unpolished exterior matrix providing a stable freestanding display base
Sparkling crystalline quartz druzy interior with varied crystal point sizes
Measures approximately 8 inches long, 5 inches wide, 6 inches tall; weighs 6.9 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimen with organic variations, surface inclusions, and raw textural variations inherent to natural rock. Crystal cavity is well-preserved with bright purple color and reflective facets. Exterior matrix is solid and structurally stable with natural clefts and rough stone textures.
